prompt: Why might the same bottle appear in two places?
promptZh: 為什麼同一款瓶裝品可能出現在兩處？

options.text: The shop sells that item on its own and inside the kit.
options.zh: 店裡有單賣這個品項，旅行組裡也有。
options.whyZh: 講者說同款可同時是組內品及架上單品。

options.text: The shop uses older bottles to mark the prices.
options.whyZh: 價標由大卡和架標提供，沒有拿舊瓶當標示。

options.text: Staff keep one bottle for each price checker.
options.zh: 員工為每台查價機各留一瓶。
options.whyZh: 查價機是掃條碼，不是瓶裝品的陳列原因。

options.text: The kit’s sleeve is printed with two barcodes for the bottle.
options.zh: 套紙印有那瓶的兩個條碼。
options.whyZh: 講者區分瓶身的條碼和旅行組外套紙的條碼，沒有說套紙印了兩個瓶身條碼。

explanationZh: 講者說同款可同時是組內品及架上單品。
evidence: We sell the kit as well as the individual items, so the same bottle can appear in both places.

vocabulary.note: 可單獨販售而非只能買整組。
